title.narrative: Improved coherence in support and action to facilitate transition from the informal to the formal economy

description.narrative: The following are the major deliverables and activities of the ILO in this area. (1) Development of the evidence base, including statistics, on informality, its consequences, its drivers and the opportunities for change, to foster among constituents and within the multilateral system a shared understanding of the necessity to act on integrated and gender-transformative pathways to formality, in line with Recommendation No. 204 (2) Building, jointly with UN agencies and international financial institutions and through social dialogue, coherence and synergies at national or sectoral levels between different policy interventions contributing to the transition to formality through: (i) the design of innovative, integrated and gender-responsive strategies; and (ii) the development of coordination mechanisms and other institutional arrangements. (3) Awareness raising about the advantages of adopting coherent and integrated approaches on transition to formality and capacity building, in cooperation with the Turin Centre, to implement such approaches, including through exchanges of experiences between countries and regions. (4) Tools and innovative approaches, including through the use of digital technologies, on integrated approaches to formalization. (5) Research, tools, data and publications on informality, risks of informalization and formalization policies and measures. (6) Partnerships, with the active participation of constituents, with UN agencies and international financial institutions and enhanced development cooperation to develop joint policy initiatives and research on transition to formality.
